title: Test case: error bound for one decoder, op count for another

claims.statement: Let f(u) = (u, u) and let g be maximum-likelihood decoding with ties broken by independent fair coins: g(y)_i = y_i if y_i = y_(1000+i), and otherwise a uniform random bit. On BSC(1/10) with a uniform message, eps(f, g) = 1 - (9/10)^1000 <= (10^46 - 1)/10^46.
For the same code and ML decoder g, g executes at most W = 33 <= 2^(101/20) operations of the bsc-ops-v1 model on every received word.

experiments.purpose: Check 9^1000 * 10^46 >= 10^1000 with exact integers, which is equivalent to (9/10)^1000 >= 10^-46.
